[14 August 2026]{.date}

#### UCLightCommands Hackathon × Thorlabs

10 students, from undergrads to postdocs, designed a new demo with Thorlabs based on the LightCommands study: hacking microphones with a modulated laser. Showcased in October, and v2 is on its way! 🚀
